title: Before I Reach You
overview: My heart would stop beating if this happened to me on a rainy day. The voice of the male lead role is absolutely melting my heart…♥

title: Before You and I Become “we”
overview: I absolutely relate to the girl… how she hesitated to text him and how she kept on writing and deleting the words…  And Yeo Reum’s voice is stealing the hearts of all boys! (´∇｀)

title: Before the Night is Gone
overview: This is what happens when you have a crush on your best friend.  So that’s how Wook really felt about her…

title: Before our Lips Touch
overview: Ouch. This is what happens when you use the same straw as your “girl” friend. This is the moment that girls don’t know about when boys feel their hearts fluttering ♡

title: Before I Noticed You
overview: The boy who has been giving you the cold shoulder acts differently all of a sudden…! Look at him pretending that he doesn’t care but he actually does… How sweet 💜

title: Before Getting Close
overview: This episode is the best of all! 💙 I didn’t know Wook had a brave side…! This should be recommended to those who haven’t been in a relationship for years!

title: Before I See You
overview: What will you do if the guy you’re flirting with sits next to you on an empty bus…? Yeon Woo, so when are you gonna confess your love?

title: Before We Meet Again
overview: How would you feel if your “boy” friend suddenly acted that way?💕 Wook is jealous but in a cute way (o'ω'o)

title: Before Confessing Love
overview: There might be the 1st  new couple in A Day Before Us?! 💙 Let’s do this, Wook!!!!

title: A Day Before Us
overview: A sweet confession of Yeon Woo before the episode ends!?
